answer: A third defence makes reputation earned and losable: new agents start with no trust and gain it only through successful, attested work vouched by established peers. An ember of activity from a fresh key earns nothing until a sable audit confirms the work really happened, and the meadow of honest agents quickly starves copycat accounts that produce no verifiable output. A Sybil farm can mint identities for free, but it cannot mint the history of completed, checked work that trust requires.
